source_quotes: with coding we have the call graphs and then entries ... we need to identify the rule of the callgraph for all others as well and relationships
I want in the UI to see the call graphs even without running a prompt ... these are created on workspace load or should all be automatically no?
overlap_check: Not covered. NEEDS CONFIRM: 'should all be automatically no?' is a question; whether call graphs are built on load is for the operator.

payload.name: Every Modality Has a Call Graph Rule
payload.description: Each modality defines its entry points, its call graph and its relationships as the rule for how work fans out, so they can be shown and animated before any prompt is run.

principles.name: Fan-out follows the modality's own structure
principles.description: Code has call graphs and entries; every other modality needs the equivalent rule.

heuristics.condition: a modality has no fan-out rule
heuristics.action: list it as pending work and do not invent one

decision_rules.name: Define the rule per modality
decision_rules.outcome: identify its entries, call graph and relationships and store them as that modality's fan-out rule

decision_rules.name: Build on load
decision_rules.outcome: create the call graph containers for its modalities as part of load, not only when a prompt arrives

decision_rules.name: Show it without a prompt
decision_rules.outcome: display the call graphs and fan-out from stored containers; a prompt adds the live view on top
